Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你喜欢悬疑电影吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you like mystery movies?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Depends on who I'm watching with

Content.SourceString: 我很喜欢，正好最近在一部部补完呗果的《悬疑电影TOP200榜单》。
Content.LocalizedString: I do! I'm actually working my way through Bagel's "Top 200 Mystery Movies" list right now.

Content.SourceString: 说不上喜不喜欢……差不多是只看过一些经典作品，如果剧情梗概吸引人，偶尔会看看的程度。
Content.LocalizedString: I can't really say I like or dislike them… I've mostly just seen some of the classics, and I'll occasionally watch one if the plot sounds appealing.

Content.SourceString: 要是喜欢这种题材的朋友推荐，我可能会看看。不过要是对方太狂热了，忍不住给我剧透，也会有点困扰……
Content.LocalizedString: If a friend who's into that genre recommends something, I might give it a watch. Though if they get too enthusiastic and can't help spoiling things, that would be a bit of a problem…

Content.SourceString: 骄傲.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: proud.jpg

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然问这个？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you suddenly asking about that?

Content.SourceString: 我正巧拿到两张票。有空的话，今晚要不要一起去汽车影院？就当是补偿之前我家那两只小猫头鹰给你惹的麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString: I just happened to get two tickets. If you're free tonight, would you like to go to the drive-in theater together? Think of it as me making up for the trouble my two little owls caused you before.

Content.SourceString: 算不上什么麻烦。但既然是九原小姐邀请，我也很乐意同行。
Content.LocalizedString: It wasn't really any trouble. But since you're inviting me, I'd be happy to come along.

Content.SourceString: 既然是九原小姐的邀请，我就不客气了。
Content.LocalizedString: Since you're inviting me, I won't be shy about accepting.

Content.SourceString: 微笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: smile.jpg

Content.SourceString: 微笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: smile.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，要一起去兜风吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, want to go for a drive?

Content.SourceString: 图片.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: picture.jpg

Content.SourceString: 怎么又这么突然？
Content.LocalizedString: Why is this so sudden again?

Content.SourceString: 之前在汽车影院，感觉你似乎没玩尽兴。
Content.LocalizedString: At the drive-in theater earlier, I got the feeling you didn't really have as much fun as you could have.

Content.SourceString: wink.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: wink.jpg

Content.SourceString: 没有这种事，我玩得很开心。
Content.LocalizedString: No, that's not true at all. I had a great time.

Content.SourceString: ……被九原小姐发现了。
Content.LocalizedString: …You saw right through me, Jiuyuan.

Content.SourceString: 那就当做另一次单纯的出游邀请吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Then let's just think of it as another simple invitation to go out together.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Since you put it that way…

Content.SourceString: 毕竟是雷加利亚，只用来看电影，总感觉有点心痒。
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, it's a Regalia. Using it just to watch movies… I can't help feeling like there's more we could be doing.

Content.SourceString: 既然九原小姐都这么说了……
Content.LocalizedString: Since you put it that way, Jiuyuan…

Content.SourceString: 出门吧，我去接你。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's go out then. I'll come pick you up.

Content.SourceString: wink.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: wink.jpg

Content.SourceString: wink.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: wink.jpg

Content.SourceString: 有时间来斯特利吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Got time to stop by Sterry?

Content.SourceString: 最近斯特利的两个小家伙一直在念叨着你。
Content.LocalizedString: The two little ones at Sterry have been talking about you a lot lately.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Shh! I'm in the middle of training…

Content.SourceString: 嘘！我在进行不说话不发消息戒除网络的心境练习。
Content.LocalizedString: Shh! I'm practicing a mental discipline where I don't talk or send messages. A digital detox thing.

Content.SourceString: 九原小姐是有什么要紧事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is something the matter?

Content.SourceString: 听起来倒是一种有趣的练习方式。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually sounds like an interesting way to train.

Content.SourceString: 倒也没有什么要紧事……
Content.LocalizedString: No, nothing urgent, really…

Content.SourceString: 前几日店里新装了家庭影院系统，两个小猫头鹰喜欢《十五年的真相》这部电影挺久，嚷嚷着要和鉴定师一起看。
Content.LocalizedString: We just installed a home theater system at the shop a few days ago. The two little owls have been into this movie "The Truth of Fifteen Years" for a while now, They've been pestering me to watch it with you.

Content.SourceString: 我倒是很乐意邀请鉴定师，不过在此之前，得先确定下，鉴定师平时里喜欢看什么类型的电影？
Content.LocalizedString: I'd be more than happy to invite you, but before that, I need to know: what kind of movies do you usually like?

Content.SourceString: 热血，就要燃起来啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Action! The kind that gets you fired up!

Content.SourceString: 我会更倾向于纪录片。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd lean more towards documentaries.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师也会被英雄化的情节打动呢~
Content.LocalizedString: So even you can be moved by a heroic storyline!

Content.SourceString: 这类电影脉络清晰，内容详实……果然是鉴定师的风格呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Clear narrative structure, rich in detail… That's so like you!

Content.SourceString: 相关的电影呗果倒是也有推荐。
Content.LocalizedString: Bagel actually has some recommendations for similar movies, too.

Content.SourceString: 或许之后我可以搜集一些相关影片，还请鉴定师挑选一番，看看是否符合你的口味~
Content.LocalizedString: Perhaps I can collect some related videos later. You can look through them and see if any suit your taste!

Content.SourceString: 期待.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 度假.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: vacation.jpg

Content.SourceString: 问号.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: questionmark.jpg

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，被你发现了，我只是随手试了下传说中的新表情功能。
Content.LocalizedString: Oops, you caught me. I was just trying out that new sticker feature everyone's been talking about.

Content.SourceString: 据说只要发个表情，就会跳出一些额外的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Apparently, if you send a sticker, some bonus stuff pops up.

Content.SourceString: 看来是失败了呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like that was a bust.

Content.SourceString: 为什么是度假？九原小姐是想去度假吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Why vacation? Are you thinking about taking one?

Content.SourceString: 大概没有人会拒绝度假。
Content.LocalizedString: I doubt anyone would say no to a vacation.

OptionText.SourceString: 九原小姐去过很多地方吗？
OptionText.LocalizedString: Have you been to many places?

Content.SourceString: 听上去九原小姐可能去过很多地方？
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds like you might have been to quite a few places?

Content.SourceString: 哦？这算是另外的情报需求吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh? Is this a separate intel request?

Content.SourceString: 看在朋友的面子上，附赠一些额外的消息也不是不行~
Content.LocalizedString: For a friend, I suppose I could throw in a little extra info on the house.

Content.SourceString: 海特洛市外的景色啊，大概只要你愿意出去走走，总能遇到点有趣的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: The sights outside Hethereau? As long as you're willing to get out there, you'll always find something interesting.

Content.SourceString: 好有用的情报！真是让人意外！
Content.LocalizedString: Such useful intel! What a surprise!

Content.SourceString: 不然怎么是免费情报呢，这天上可不会掉馅饼。
Content.LocalizedString: Well, that's why it's free intel. There's no such thing as a free lunch, you know.

OptionText.SourceString: 那九原小姐想去哪度假？
OptionText.LocalizedString: So where would you like to go for vacation?

Content.SourceString: 那九原小姐会倾向于什么样的度假方式呢？这个可以告诉我吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Then what kind of vacation would you prefer? Can you tell me that much?

Content.SourceString: 大概会挑个春夏交替的时节，在海边歇一阵子，看海浪起伏，听风拂礁石……
Content.LocalizedString: Probably somewhere by the sea, around the turn of spring and summer. Rest there for a while, watching the waves rise and fall, listening to the wind blow across the rocks…

Content.SourceString: 哦~有客人到访了，度假的事情，等工作结束后再说。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, a customer just arrived. We can talk about vacation plans after I'm done with work.

Content.SourceString: 加油.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: youcandoit.jpg

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 刚处理完委托，路过花店见到一束玫瑰开得正艳，颜色挺特别，让人不自觉多看两眼。
Content.LocalizedString: Just finished a commission and passed by a florist. There was a bouquet of roses in full bloom, with a rather unique color. Couldn't help but take a second look.

OptionText.SourceString: 刚处理完委托，路过花店见到一束玫瑰开得正艳，颜色挺特别，让人不自觉多看两眼。
OptionText.LocalizedString: Just finished a commission and passed by a florist. There was a bouquet of roses in full bloom, with a rather unique color. Couldn't help but take a second look.

Content.SourceString: 那是什么颜色？
Content.LocalizedString: What color was it?

Content.SourceString: 浅白带点蓝色晕染。像是很有主见的花朵。
Content.LocalizedString: Pale white with hints of blue bleeding through. Like a flower with a mind of its own.

Content.SourceString: 不过另我好奇的是，你平时对玫瑰感兴趣吗？
Content.LocalizedString: But now I'm curious. Are you usually interested in roses?

Content.SourceString: 可能得看玫瑰的品种，大多数时候都挺喜欢的。
Content.LocalizedString: Depends on the variety, I guess. But I like them most of the time.

Content.SourceString: 那倒挺符合你这个鉴定师的口味，总挑些有意思的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: That sounds about right for you. Always picking out the interesting stuff.

OptionText.LocalizedString: I feel like there's more to that…

Content.SourceString: 总感觉话里有话……九原小姐是想做什么吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I feel like there's more to that… Are you planning something?

Content.SourceString: 没什么危险的事，只是花店那边最近有个插花体验课，我顺手占了个名额。
Content.LocalizedString: Nothing dangerous. The florist's been offering a flower arranging class lately, and I happened to grab a spot.

Content.SourceString: 对方说还能再加一位。
Content.LocalizedString: They said there's room for one more.

Content.SourceString: 如果你有空，不如一起，我想看看你会怎么摆放那朵玫瑰。
Content.LocalizedString: If you're free, why not join me? I'd love to see how you'd arrange a bouquet.

Content.SourceString: 既然是九原小姐的邀请，我会准时到场。
Content.LocalizedString: Since you're inviting me, I'll be sure to be there on time.

Content.SourceString: 稍后会把时间和地点发送给你~那我们约好了，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll send you the time and location later. It's a date then.

Content.SourceString: 约定.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: promise.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 是我，九原小姐是有什么要紧事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: It's me. Is something the matter?

Content.SourceString: 倒也不是什么要紧事，只是最近遇到了一个难题，想问问鉴定师的意见。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not exactly urgent. I've just run into a bit of a problem lately and wanted to get your opinion on it.

Content.SourceString: 九原小姐也会遇到难题吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Even you run into problems, Jiuyuan?

Content.SourceString: 难题！好！我最喜欢答题了！
Content.LocalizedString: A problem! Great, I love solving problems!

Content.SourceString: 斯特利可是每时每刻都会遇到各种难题呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Sterry runs into all sorts of problems every day, you know!

Content.SourceString: 真是特别的回答。
Content.LocalizedString: What a unique answer.

Content.SourceString: 那天店里来了一位新客人，看上去挺不错的样子，只是我不知道，应该如何与他交朋友。
Content.LocalizedString: A new customer came to the shop the other day. He seemed really nice, but I'm not sure how to make friends with him.

Content.SourceString: 这位朋友我认识吗……？
Content.LocalizedString: Do I know this friend of yours…?

Content.SourceString: 九原小姐口中的这位朋友，不会是我自己吧？！
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, the friend you're talking about… that's me, isn't it?!

Content.SourceString: 你很熟悉哦~
Content.LocalizedString: You really know your stuff!

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，被发现了。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh my, you figured it out.

Content.SourceString: 我还以为自己隐藏得很好呢。
Content.LocalizedString: And here I thought I was hiding it so well.

Content.SourceString: 就当是闲聊好了，鉴定师，你说如何与他交朋友比较好呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Just between us. What do you think is the best way to make friends with someone?

Content.SourceString: 真诚是必杀技……我会更愿意跟坦诚的人打交道。
Content.LocalizedString: Sincerity is your secret weapon… I do prefer dealing with honest people.

Content.SourceString: 可能需要一些时间，增强对彼此的了解……？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe we need some time to… get to know each other better…?

Content.SourceString: 真是可爱的回答。
Content.LocalizedString: What a sweet answer.

Content.SourceString: 还真是坦诚的答案。
Content.LocalizedString: What an honest answer.

Content.SourceString: 那接下来，就请鉴定师多多指教了~
Content.LocalizedString: Well then, I'll be in your care from here on!

Content.SourceString: 这次的拍卖会，鉴定师可是表现得很抢眼呢~
Content.LocalizedString: You really stood out at the auction this time!

Content.SourceString: 强大.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: powerful.jpg

Content.SourceString: 九原小姐客气了……斯特利的回礼也很丰厚……
Content.LocalizedString: That's flattering… Sterry's gift was quite generous too…

Content.SourceString: 只是希望鉴定师没有被「不速之客」扰了兴致，惠比寿的骚动，如果没有鉴定师的能力，可没有这么轻松就收尾。
Content.LocalizedString: I just hope those uninvited guests didn't spoil your evening. Without your abilities, the commotion at Ebisu wouldn't have been resolved so easily.

Content.SourceString: 九原小姐知道不速之客的来历吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you know where these uninvited guests came from?

Content.SourceString: 来历自然是知道，毕竟海特洛市的消息，也没有做到密不透风的时候，只是……
Content.LocalizedString: Of course I know. After all, news in Hethereau is never completely airtight. It's just…

Content.SourceString: 只是什么……？
Content.LocalizedString: Just what…?

Content.SourceString: 情报可都是有代价的。有时候，了解得越多，越是容易深陷其中。
Content.LocalizedString: Intel always comes at a price. Sometimes, the more you know, the easier it is to get caught up in it all.

Content.SourceString: 不知道鉴定师，有没有做好参与的准备呢。
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder… are you ready to get involved?

OptionText.SourceString: 如果有报酬，也不是不行。
OptionText.LocalizedString: If there's payment involved, I wouldn't say no.

Content.SourceString: 如果斯特利有需要的话，一些相关的委托，我也是可以接受的。
Content.LocalizedString: If Sterry ever needs a hand, I'd be happy to take on some related commissions.

Content.SourceString: 哦~看上去你已经有了觉悟。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh? Looks like you've made up your mind.

Content.SourceString: 我想，接下来的日子会越来越有趣~
Content.LocalizedString: I have a feeling things are going to get more and more interesting from here on out!
